Chapter 6469: What Is This?

Chapter 6469: What Is This?

“No!!!” Rising and Earthsplitter shouted in horror, seeing the gates of hell before their very eyes.

They reacted swiftly and summoned their defenses including the strongest treasures and merit laws. They began burning their true fate as well.

“Bam!” Alas, even their towering trees were crushed along with their defenses. Escaping from his palm was impossible.

They didn’t have the chance to scream before being pressed against the ground. A palm print was formed with them lying bloodied in the center.

They looked like two mosquitoes killed by a slap, flattened and stuck to the palm. Their primal anima nearly crumbled.

Silence took over Gold Village. None could have envisioned this outcome - two primal ancestors being beaten by a single slap.

Ocean-gaze and Iron-spear were pale since the same could have happened to them. Now, everyone understood why Li Qiye received so much respect from the top cultivators.

“Such force.” Alch-deer murmured.

As for Black Wind, his legs gave in and he fell to the ground. Everything turned dark as he fainted despite being a desolate god.

As the two looked up in the sky while their blood flowed freely, they understood how desperate the situation was. Despair struck the core of their soul.

“Still haven’t told me how you two want to die.” Li Qiye smiled.

Suddenly, loud explosions came from outside. A unique beam pierced Gold Village and a foreign aura invaded the inhabitants.

“What’s going on?!” They looked up and saw a larger world approaching violently.

“Paragon Realm!” Alch-deer’s expression changed.

“Paragon Realm?!” Ocean-gaze and Luosha became startled.

Three major realms existed in the dream world - Gold Village, Paramount, and Paragon. They seldom made contact due to the distance and certain fundamental differences.

A lord of Gold Village would lose his powers when visiting the other two realms and vice versa. Now, something from Paragon was infiltrating Gold Village, virtually pinning all inhabitants to the ground.

“Go!” Alch-deer released all of his golden power.

“Go!” His allies did the same and channeled their power into his.

“Give the lord our power!” Others knew the direness of the situation - Paragon smashing into Gold Village.

Because of this, both outsiders and natives gave their best to help Alch-deer.

All over Sea of Heavenly Sin, everyone saw the dream of Paragon stretching infinitely toward the dream of Gold Village.

Meanwhile, everyone inside channeled their power, forming an unbreakable golden barrier. Nevertheless, the other side was just as formidable for some reason, intending to break through.

The barrier’s collapse seemed to be a matter of time.

“How can there be so much paragon power?” Alch-deer himself couldn’t believe it. The so-called paragon power multiplied with no end in sight.

“This is bad...” Alch-deer murmured as the paragon power drew back for a moment, preparing for an ultimate smash.
